verdict.rationale: Airwallex's own docs say it issues corporate cards with custom spend limits, which covers the amount-restriction part of the story. Nothing in the pack shows category or merchant restrictions, or real-time declines or auto-locks at the point of sale. The 'apply your spend rules automatically' claim concerns after-the-fact auditing of expense reports, not authorization-time controls. Missing for 10: merchant-category restrictions, merchant-level allow/block lists, documented point-of-sale decline or auto-lock enforcement, detailed card-controls documentation, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a finance lead, I can restrict cards by category, merchant, and amount — and the platform auto-locks or declines out-of-policy spend at the point of sale
